test_case.purpose: Run the pinned thermal qualification profile under approved ambient/load conditions and verify every sensor, throttle, power and error limit.

test_case.pass_fail_basis: Readable output or correct FW alone cannot PASS thermal qualification.
test_case.recovery: Abort load, cool down, preserve logs and verify GPU/platform health before any rerun.
